_readme: Supplier page details for The Fleet Magazine, gathered 17 Nov 2026 from each company's own website (title, meta description, header logo). Where the site gave no usable logo, the logo is from the company's Wikimedia Commons file. dark:true means the logo is white and is shown on a dark tile. An empty website or logo means we could not confirm one: leave it empty rather than guess. Sector drives the filter on the hub.

Adrian Flux.line: Specialist insurance broker covering vans, commercial vehicles, cars and homes.

Alpine.line: Renault Group's electric sports car brand.

Arnold Clark.line: UK motor retailer selling new and used cars and vans.

AX.line: Credit hire, fleet management and day rate insurance, keeping drivers on the road after an accident.

AXA.line: Insurer offering commercial vehicle, fleet and business cover.

Ayvens.line: Car and van leasing and fleet management, part of Societe Generale.

Black Horse.line: Motor finance provider working through a network of more than 4,500 UK dealers.

bp pulse.line: bp's electric vehicle charging network and fleet charging business.

BYD.line: Electric and plug-in hybrid vehicle maker, and developer of the Blade battery.

Cap HPI.line: Vehicle valuation and data provider, part of Solera.

Changan.line: Chinese car maker selling electric SUVs in the UK under the Deepal name.

Citroën.line: Car and van maker, part of Stellantis.

DAF Trucks.line: Truck maker, building the XG, XF, XD and XB ranges.

Dan Ryan Truck Rental.line: Truck and van rental, contract leasing and ex-fleet sales, Ireland's first truck rental company.

Dawsongroup.line: Supplies and maintains trucks, trailers, vans and other assets on rental and contract hire.

Dealer Auction.line: Trade to trade online auction for used vehicles.

Don-Bur.line: UK manufacturer of commercial vehicle trailers and rigid bodywork.

DriveStable.line: Vehicle passport platform for car owners, builds and fleets.

Echoes.line: Fleet management platform that runs on manufacturers' own vehicle data, with no hardware to fit.

Electra Commercial Vehicles.line: UK builder of electric refuse trucks and specialist commercial vehicles.

Europcar.line: Car and van hire in the UK and worldwide.

Fellten.line: Designs and builds modular energy storage and battery packs, including the Charge Qube.

Fleet Alliance.line: Fleet management and leasing company managing more than 70,000 vehicles.

Fleet Assist.line: Independent supply chain management and consultancy for the fleet industry.

Fleet Service GB.line: Integrated driver and vehicle fleet management with UK-based 24/7 support.

FleetCheck.line: Fleet management software used by more than 2,500 UK fleets.

Fleetclear.line: Fleet safety, tracking, telematics and camera systems, including DVS and FORS kit.

FleetDue.line: Vehicle checks, defects, maintenance and MOT and tax reminders in one UK fleet workspace.

FMG.line: Incident and accident management for fleets and insurers.

Ford.line: Car, van and pickup maker, selling to business through Ford Pro.

Fuuse.line: Charge point management software for fleets, workplaces and public networks.

Gophr.line: Same day courier service, from bikes to vans.

HTC Group.line: DAF dealer and commercial vehicle services provider in the south of England.

Humax.line: Charging hardware maker, working with Paua on depot EV charging for fleets.

InstaVolt.line: Public ultra-rapid electric vehicle charging network.

Isotrak.line: Telematics provider covering vehicle tracking and AI dash cameras.

Isuzu.line: Maker of the D-Max pickup, in diesel and electric.

IVECO.line: Truck and van maker, building the Daily, Eurocargo and S-Way ranges.

Jeep.line: 4x4 and SUV maker, part of Stellantis.

KEYper Systems.line: Key management and asset control systems, formerly Traka Automotive in the UK.

Leapmotor.line: Electric car and SUV maker, sold in Europe through Leapmotor International.

Leasys.line: Car and van contract hire, rental and fleet services.

Lex Autolease.line: One of the UK's largest vehicle leasing companies.

Microlise.line: Telematics and transport technology for fleet operators.

Nissan.line: Car and van maker, building cars in Sunderland.

NVIDIA.line: Maker of AI computing chips and platforms, including for autonomous vehicles.

OnPoint Systems.line: Compliance software on the DVSA Earned Recognition approved list.

Optimo Energy.line: Charging and energy management software for electric fleets and depots.

Paua.line: EV charging payment and management platform for fleets and businesses.

Peugeot.line: Car and van maker, part of Stellantis.

Renault Trucks.line: Truck and light commercial vehicle maker.

Rivetway.line: Transport and fleet management software for job management, walkaround checks and compliance.

Stagecoach.line: Bus operator that has opened its depot charging to other fleets.

Stellantis.line: Car and van group behind Citroen, Fiat, Jeep, Peugeot and Vauxhall.

The AA.line: Breakdown cover and roadside assistance, with insurance and driver services.

Transparent Laden.line: App that compares nearby EV charging prices before you plug in.

Trents.line: Vehicle recycler and supplier of used parts, trading for more than 90 years.

Trimble.line: Fleet, transport and logistics management software.

Vauxhall.line: Car and van maker, part of Stellantis.

VDO.line: Tachograph and fleet services brand, part of Continental.

Venson.line: Fleet management covering acquisition, funding, maintenance and duty of care.

VisionTrack.line: AI video telematics and connected cameras for fleets.

Voltloader.line: Electric HGVs and charging for operators moving bulk products.

Wayve.line: Developer of AI for assisted and automated driving.

Webfleet.line: Fleet management and telematics, part of Bridgestone.

Zapmap.line: App to find and pay for EV charging across the UK.
